sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Ice Bricks is a game about timing and reflexes. The gameplay mechanics are identical to those of Pong, with two paddles at the bottom of the screen and a ball bouncing back and forth. The twist is that the ball is a small snowball, and the game takes place on an icy surface. Your objective is to collect as many bounces as possible by hitting the snowball with your paddle. The game gets progressively harder as you collect more bounces, requiring you to move faster and more precisely to keep up with the increasing speed of the snowball.
One of the most appealing aspects of Ice Bricks is its simplicity. The game is easy to pick up, but difficult to master. This makes it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. The controls are also very responsive, making it easy to navigate the game's icy surface. Whether you're using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, you'll feel right at home in the world of Ice Bricks.
Ice Bricks also features a unique scoring system that rewards players for their speed and accuracy. The more bounces you collect, the higher your score will be.
